artist.name: Dean Lewis
artist.short_description: Dean Lewis is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Dean Lewis is an Australian singer-songwriter recognized for emotionally direct pop with acoustic and piano-led roots. His early work included 'Waves' and 'Be Alright,' followed by his debut album A Place We Knew in 2019. He expanded that sound with The Hardest Love in 2022 and later releases including The Epilogue. Lewis has discussed how writing vulnerably can help listeners connect to a song, even when the original story feels highly personal. One of his best documented tracks is 'How Do I Say Goodbye,' which he wrote while his father was seriously ill and he feared losing him. Lewis later described his father's recovery and the experience of sharing the song with him. In other interviews he has explained the relationship contexts behind tracks on The Hardest Love, including 'All For You' and 'Hurtless.' Afterglow can use his catalogue as a reference point for breakup, reconciliation and family-loss material, but should not confuse different songs with similar titles by other artists. Release-year fields should be checked at recording level because some tracks are available on newer compilations.
